sentences.en: Existing legislation does not take diversity of races into account.
sentences.zh: 现有的法律并没有考虑到种族多样性。

sentences.en: Individuals do not exist for the development of the State.
sentences.zh: 个人的存在并不为了国家的发展。

sentences.en: If God did not exist, we'd have to invent him.
sentences.zh: 如果上帝不存在，我们或许得把他创造出来。
